we have developed a practical and efficient security model for Secure 2-party statistical analysis, based on which, we have designed a number of building block protocols to solve the Secure 2-party linear regression and classification problems.
we have designed and implemented a practical security model and a number of building block protocols to support the two Secure 2-Party Multivariate Statistical Analysis problems.

(1) We have developed a new privacy-preserving multivariate statistical analysis technique that is secure in the standard model, (2) We have developed the first practical secure 2-party multivariable linear regression protocol, and (3) We have developed an efficient secure 2-party classification protocol that can handle both linear and non-linear classification models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of efficient and secure multivariate statistical analysis techniques in the S2C framework.

the following issues: (1) how to securely compute multivariate statistical analysis on joint data of two parties; (2) how to securely conduct multivariate linear regression and multivariate classification on joint data of the two parties; (3) how to develop a secure model and a practical building block for secure multivariate statistical analysis; and (4) how to conduct secure multivariate statistical data analysis in the real world.

the following issues: (1) how to securely compute the linear regression and classification on two private data sets; (2) how to securely aggregate two sets of private data; (3) how to efficiently and securely compute the linear transformation of a private data set and (4) how to securely and efficiently compute the linear combination of private data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Secure 2-party statistical analysis methods are practical and efficient.

we have proposed a practical solution for the Secure Multivariate Linear Regression and Secure 2-Party Multivariate Classification problems in S2C framework, where the security of the proposed protocols is based on the hardness of the Computational Diffie-Hellman problem in a bilinear group.
our work has developed a practical security framework for solving Secure 2-party Linear Regression and Classification problems, and the framework has been implemented and tested on a real data set.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed and implemented a practical and efficient Secure 2-party statistical analysis method for both linear regression and classification.

, in this paper, we have proposed a new security model, developed a number of new building blocks for solving the two Secure 2-Party Multivariate Statistical Analysis problems, and implemented a number of these building blocks.
we are the first to develop a secure multivariate linear regression method and a secure multivariate classification method in Secure 2-Party Computation framework.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the S2P multivariate statistical analysis problem is not as difficult to solve as it seems.
we have shown that it is possible to conduct multivariate statistical analysis in a secure manner, and we have demonstrated how to conduct multivariate linear regression and classification securely.
